events.name: The invention of writing
events.hook: Temple clerks in Sumer pressed marks into clay to count sheep and barley, and history began.

events.name: Building the Great Pyramid
events.hook: For nearly 4,000 years the tomb of King Khufu was the tallest building on Earth.

events.name: The Bronze Age collapse
events.hook: Within fifty years the great kingdoms of the eastern Mediterranean fell, and no one is sure why.

events.name: The Trojan War
events.hook: A legend of a stolen queen, a ten-year siege and a wooden horse, with a real burned city underneath.

events.name: The first Olympic Games
events.hook: One footrace at a shrine of Zeus began a festival that lasted a thousand years and came back in 1896.

events.name: The Greco-Persian Wars
events.hook: The largest empire on Earth twice invaded Greece, and was beaten at Marathon, Salamis and Plataea.

events.name: The Peloponnesian War
events.hook: Athens and Sparta fought for 27 years, and the golden age of Athens ended in plague, defeat and hunger.

events.name: Alexander's conquest of Persia
events.hook: In eleven years a young king of Macedon marched from Greece to India and toppled the Persian Empire.

events.name: The Punic Wars
events.hook: Rome and Carthage fought three wars for the Mediterranean, and only one city survived.

events.name: The Qin unification of China
events.hook: After centuries of war one kingdom swallowed the other six, and its king made himself the First Emperor.

events.name: Columbus's first voyage
events.hook: Three small ships sailed west to find Asia and found a world Europe did not know.
